reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: Well, through the soft, forgiving lens of nostalgia,
foreground_english.zh: 隔着怀旧那层柔光滤镜，

foreground_english.en: and you'll excuse the pun of lens,
you'll forgive him, because he's going to be paying for that camera,
foreground_english.zh: 你会原谅他，反正摄像机他得赔，

foreground_english.en: and he'll be happy to put his hand in his pocket if he wins this match.
foreground_english.zh: 只要赢下这场，他掏钱也乐意。

profanity_check: 两档转写在这一窗口里都没有脏话；按交接文档「如果确认有脏话」的条件，不消音。
review_note: 球拍砸向网上摄像机（308–323 秒近景），解说原声两档一致（small 310.38–325.36；medium 307.02–325.78）。两档转写里都没有梅德韦杰夫本人的话，未见脏话，不消音。
